symbols.name: bit length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two integers being multiplied.
symbols.quote: The Schönhage–Strassen optimality conjecture is the claim that $n\log n$ is the best possible order of growth for the time to multiply two integers, where $n$ is the number of bits in each; it is the statement that the main result of this wiki disproves.

symbols.name: power saving
symbols.meaning: A fixed positive constant, the amount by which the exponent of the logarithm is lowered.
symbols.quote: Its running time is $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$, where $\kappa>0$ is a fixed constant, the amount by which the exponent of the logarithm is lowered.

relations.quote: The conjecture is stated for the [Fixed finite-tape machine model](machine-model.md): a multitape Turing machine with a fixed alphabet and a fixed number of one-dimensional tapes.
